body:
Migrated from docs/agent-memory/ideas.md (entry dated 2026-09-19); widened by the owner on 2026-10-11.

Original recommendation (owner-accepted): `make gate-affected` (local) and `tools/corvint-pr-tests` (CI) plan the same selection through different drivers. A single runner would take a base, plan through `corvint affected`, select, run, and fall back to the full suite the same way on a laptop and a hosted runner, with CI adding only the trusted-pin admission.

Widened scope (2026-10-11): Corvint calls the test runners itself through registered per-runner adapters that receive only the selected targets and use the runner's native target filter, so each session builds only what its tests need (Go first; cargo, swift, dotnet, gradle and Playwright each need their own adapter qualification). Sharding becomes selection-aware: the default keeps the AFP-V0-022 complete-universe partition intersected with the run set; an experimental balanced placement partitions the run set itself so narrowed runs use every shard, with a `verify-shards` fan-in that proves exactly-once coverage. Every run writes a bounded `corvint-test-run/0` receipt.

Spec: docs/specs/session-test-runner-v0.md (STR-V0-001..016, proposed). Qualification is tied to the current driver's identity, so the call sites move only after the STR-V0-013 parity report, and the CI switch needs AFP-V0-016 consent and a new AFP-V0-030 forward epoch. AFP-V0-028..030 admission and the AFP-V0-029 shadow bar are unchanged. Balanced placement promotion and non-Go adapters are separate follow-ups, not required to close this ticket.
